_about: Hand-checked pairs shown as 'Often mistaken for'. kind=face: people who look alike; kind=name: people with confusable names. Face pairs need a source that names both people; build/verify-pairs.js checks this and records the date. Name pairs whose names are the same or sound the same need no source. Names are English Wikipedia titles.
